description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Storm-Kiln Artist, Blood Funnel and Sedgemoor Witch trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Resolve the Sedgemoor Witch trigger, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Pest token.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.
